review_description: All enquiries easily answered, no ifs or buts, eg pregnant pauses followed by tech gobbledygook .I have done my own research and checked his info against mine.Explained ALL my requirements to him, and allowed him to run a ruler over them.All pros and cons were considered, including positive or negative implications.Each decision was revisited at a later date for accuracy . Note: Quotation and Installation by same business.Installation team arrived early, confirmed all necessary details, then began work. I wasn’t chased away by the team boss each time I approached to check if all was going OK.ENTIRE installation went as planned. Was present during commissioning procedures, no faults seen then or since. Very happy.
Great to deal with & delivered on all promises. Fantastic price for quality gear. SMA Inverter,  & REC PE250 Panels. Very good installation job to my specification. Couldn't ask for any more.

We received good advise and professional service from Chris the sales manager. The installation was completed in good time by a very competent and skilled contractor. All paperwork was lodged with Energex promptly and so far very happy with the overall outcome.

The sales rep was able to answer all questions instantly, and was totally familiar with the range of systems available.The chosen system has been perfoming well, and I will be showing a profit in a few short years. A better investment than the stockmarket.

Glad I did my own research on this site along with lots of others and wasn't bulldozed into either an over priced system or a dodgy company exploiting the latest government rebate. The panel comparison chart on this site was a big help.
